proposed:granite_vision_4_1_4b.context_note: Native context is a model limit, not a suggested allocation. Qwen extensions and Granite 512K need separate validated long-context profiles.

vision_profile.role: Optional structured chart/table/key-value extraction; separate from the core art-description workflow.
vision_profile.vram_tier_evidence: Planning estimate only, not a measured guarantee. CPU operation needs sufficient host RAM. Disk bytes exclude context, vision and compute buffers.

vision_profile.settings_status: Verified publisher deterministic API example; complete independent document profile proposed below. Sampling fields omitted by the publisher are explicitly application choices.

publisher_generation_example.framework: OpenAI-compatible vLLM client in official README

app_profile_suggestion.note: T0 follows the publisher API example. Other sampler values are neutral application choices; top_k0 disables that filter. 8K context/2K output are proposed local caps, not publisher defaults. Allow4K output when a table/document is truncated and context budget permits.

vision_profile.reasoning_control: No thinking toggle occurs in this checkpoint template. Do not inherit Granite4.2 enable_thinking, low_effort or Qwen3-Coder tool formatting.
vision_profile.native_tools: Template supports Granite-style JSON tool objects inside tool_call tags, but document profile need not expose tools and no tool quality claim is made.

task_profile.key_value_extraction: Supply the requested JSON Schema, ask for an extracted JSON instance, null for unavailable values, and JSON only. No special KVP task tag is documented.

integration_notes: Keep the checkpoint-specific embedded template: it expands six chart/table task tags. A recognized tag replaces the rest of that user text, while preserving the image position; do not append critical per-task instructions after a tag expecting them to survive.
For KVP, provide an ordinary full text instruction with the JSON Schema and no chart/table task tag. Preserve the real image content.
The verified main GGUF plus its F16 projector is sufficient for direct inference. Docling and external OCR models are optional integrations, not required downloads.
Use one document image per request initially. The app current1024px thumbnail limits fine-text detail; do not advertise untested full-page OCR fidelity or silently enlarge the input budget.
Source support and public downloads are established; end-to-end document extraction quality on this app/backend remains unbenchmarked.
vision_profile.task_limits: IBM explicitly describes specialization in document extraction and possible weak generalization to open-ended vision tasks; English instructions only.
vision_profile.prompt_constraints: Use the native chat template: task tags such as <chart2csv>, <tables_json> and <chart2summary> expand into task instructions. Preserve those semantics if this optional document workflow is added.
